integrity: The proof reduces the blocking claim to the standard centrally symmetric boundary-cover criterion. A standalone exact-rational checker reconstructs all 24 vertices and 14 facets, verifies touching and pairwise nonoverlap, and certifies the complete facet cover by 438 terminal triangles with minimum strict slack 1/16. Relevant foundational, archive-era, and later blocking literature was compared at statement level.
scientific_limitations: The result proves only an upper bound of six for the regular truncated octahedron. It does not establish equality, does not classify other truncated octahedra, and does not extend automatically to all parallelohedra or the full cube–octahedron intersection family.
source_ids: Banach Center Publications 84 (2009), Open Problem Session, Problem 12
title: Six translates block the regular truncated octahedron
